objective: Descriptive support for roadside interactions on all 54 fixed third-cohort windows; no fitting, no outcome-based thresholds. Written after source label census and after pilot outcomes. The third-cohort archive exists; the registration author has not inspected its outcome metrics.
clock: Only final observed camera exposure t0. Use source camera-time labels at t0 and virtual-LiDAR XY centres in the same instant. No neighbor needs any future observation or persistence. Count exactly one source instance per (category,track_id) at t0. Report duplicates as errors.
distance: Planar Euclidean target-to-neighbor distance in native metric XY. Inclusion radius <=10.0 m. List distinct and overlapping windows for every class-group plus per-sequence/local-person denominators; describe nearest distance where supported. No threshold search.
classification: Count other raw category labels verbatim without recoding. Exclude only the target Pedestrian. Cyclist and Motorcyclist are separate authoritative tags; propulsion and users’ legal road classes are not independently established. The two-wheel class cannot be inferred from raw imagery.
limits: These are annotated neighbours near a pedestrian at decision time, not measured interactions, yielding, causality, future membership or a new fitted model. Validate numbers across all 54 windows without looking up forecasts. No outcome tests or claims of model benefit are registered.
